# Agent & Contributor Instructions — `catalytic-register-frontiers`

**Current Build Pipeline Phase:** `P9` (Published on GitHub `v1.0.1`, Zenodo Concept DOI `10.5281/zenodo.24517198`, Software Heritage `swh:1:snp:f960eeda6f145e54c0ac52538ace866a16e24085`, ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`, and `0thernes-research-archive` `0TH-2026-010`; Palomar/arXiv/HAL/external peer review in progress; tracked in `project.yaml`).  
**Governing Standards:** Build Standard for LLMs v1.1.0 (`repo.yaml`, `scripts/Audit-Repo.ps1`), Build Pipeline Models v1.0.0 (`project.yaml`, `scripts/pipeline-audit.py`), and Defensible Independent AI Research Playbook v1.1 (`docs/reviews/01-10-pass-review.md`, `docs/launch/release-checklist.md`).

Follow these repository invariants on every edit:

1. **Workspace & Shell Safety:** This repository lives on a bracketed Windows path (`Z:\[Vibe Coded (AI)]\ANTIGRAVITY\catalytic-register-frontiers`). Always use `-LiteralPath` in PowerShell file cmdlets, use `os.walk` instead of `glob.glob` in Python over bracketed paths, and run `pytest` repo-relative (`tests/test_all.py`).
2. **Zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35 Bar:** Every `.lean` file begins with `module` (14 core proof files, 8,151 lines total, max 1,364 lines; plus standalone Palomar contract files `PalomarChallenge.lean` [283 lines, zero imports, Comparator placeholder `sorry` only] and `PalomarSolution.lean` [842 lines]; 16 files / 9,276 lines total) and all proof/solution modules build with zero warnings under `autoImplicit=false`, `linter.unusedVariables=true`, `linter.deprecated=true` and zero `sorry`/`admit`/`native_decide`/custom `axiom`/`unsafe`/`@[extern]`. Every exported theorem in `Challenge.lean` / `Solution.lean` (`20` theorems `T1`, `T1a`–`T1e`, `T1s`, `T1es`, `T2`, `T2b`, `T3a`–`T3i`, `T4` + master conjunction) plus `Catalytic.NonVacuity.nonvac_all_hypotheses` (22 total) must pass `VerifyAxioms.lean` strictly within `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` and replay across 5 distinct locally reproducible kernel implementations in 6 runs (`lean`, `leanchecker`, `leanchecker-paranoid`, `con-leche --verified`, `con-ron --verified`, and `nanoda_bin`).
3. **Exact Arithmetic, Testing & Linters:** All computational checks in `experiments/` and `tests/` use exact integer/rational/finite-field arithmetic (`int`, `fractions.Fraction`) with no floating-point proof steps. Maintain passing Hypothesis property/metamorphic tests, mutant-killing checks, brute-force SAT encoder equivalence tests, `scripts/check_citations.py`, `ruff`, and `mypy`. Vector PDF figures must set `metadata={"CreationDate": None}`.
4. **Epistemic Integrity & Identity:** Clearly separate Tier-1..4 claims (`CLAIMS.md`, `docs/statement-fidelity.md`, `LIMITATIONS.md`). Cite primary literature (`arXiv:2609.18692`, `arXiv:2608.30238`, `doi:10.4230/LIPIcs.MFCS.2025.6`, `doi:10.1016/j.tcs.2018.02.023`) accurately without redistributing third-party PDFs. Author is `Alexander S. Donahue` (Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA; ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`; no unformed LLC claim); dual license is `Apache-2.0` (code) + `CC-BY-4.0` (prose/docs/figures).
5. **Lean Git & CI Rules (R1–R8):** Commit directly to `main`; never add git hooks, branch protection, PR templates, Dependabot, or `.github/copilot-instructions.md`. Keep CI informational-only. Classify every finding as exactly one of `{bug, error, issue, problem, dilemma, conflict}`. Regenerate LF-clean `MANIFEST.sha256` after any artifact change.
6. **Recorded N/A Tooling Decisions:**
   - *Pipeline `P5.07` (Container/Nix):* No Dockerfile or devcontainer is required because `lean/` has zero external Lake/Mathlib dependencies (pinned solely by `lean/lean-toolchain` `v4.35.0`) and Python dependencies are strictly pinned in `requirements.lock.txt`.
   - *Playbook #11 (`leanblueprint`):* Because the formalization comprises 14 self-contained zero-Mathlib modules, a static zero-dependency dependency graph and theorem-to-declaration map is published directly at `docs/index.html` (deployed via `.github/workflows/pages.yml`) instead of installing the plasTeX/Graphviz `leanblueprint` toolchain.

# Positive-Characteristic Dichotomy and Optimal Three-Register Exponents in Passive Catalytic Register Programs

[![Version 1.0.1](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.1-blue.svg)](VERSION)
[![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.24517198.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24517198)
[![Lean 4.35.0 Zero-Mathlib](https://img.shields.io/badge/Lean-4.35.0%20(zero--Mathlib)-brightgreen.svg)](lean/lean-toolchain)
[![5 Kernels / 6 Runs PASS](https://img.shields.io/badge/kernels-5%20impls%20%2F%206%20runs%20PASS-brightgreen.svg)](results/six_kernel_audit.txt)
[![Code License: Apache-2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/code%20license-Apache--2.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Docs License: CC-BY-4.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs%20license-CC--BY--4.0-lightgrey.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Status: Preprint — Not Peer Reviewed](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-preprint%20(not%20peer%20reviewed)-yellow.svg)](LIMITATIONS.md)

A zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 formalization, exact-arithmetic verification suite, and AMS-LaTeX preprint settling the exact two-register prime-field frontier and strictly improving the three-register catalytic powering exponent of Vinciguerra (`arXiv:2609.18692`).

**Author:** Alexander S. Donahue (Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA · ORCID [`0009-0006-8168-9648`](https://orcid.org/0009-0006-8168-9648) · `0_0@0thernes.art`)  
**Maintenance status:** active independent research artifact (`v1.0.1`, 2026-11-24) · **Zenodo DOI:** [`10.5281/zenodo.24517198`](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24517198) (`v1.0.1`: [`10.5281/zenodo.24517199`](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24517199)) · **Frozen White Paper:** [`dist/Donahue_2026_catalytic_register_frontiers.pdf`](dist/Donahue_2026_catalytic_register_frontiers.pdf) · **Live Adaptive Forking PWA & Blueprint:** [`0thernes.github.io/catalytic-register-frontiers`](https://0thernes.github.io/catalytic-register-frontiers/) · **SWHID:** [`swh:1:snp:f960eeda6f145e54c0ac52538ace866a16e24085`](https://archive.softwareheritage.org/api/1/snapshot/f960eeda6f145e54c0ac52538ace866a16e24085/)

> **Epistemic Status:** All 20 headline theorems, corollaries, and literal commutative-ring soundness bridges (`T1`, `T1a`–`T1e`, `T1s`, `T1es`, `T2`, `T2b`, `T3a`–`T3i` — including complete 4-register passive powering for all $N \ge 1$ and algebraic vector streaming frequency moments $F_D(\mathbf{f})$, `T4` — including machine-checked `CatOp.usesOnly` containment within $\le k + 2$ designated registers) plus concrete `0 ≠ 1` non-vacuity witnesses (`NonVacuity`, including product ring `Fin 3 → ModP 13` for `T3i`) are machine-checked from first principles in **zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0** across **14 core module files** (8,151 lines, max 1,364 lines; plus standalone Palomar contract files `PalomarChallenge.lean` [283 lines] and `PalomarSolution.lean`) and **5 distinct kernel implementations across 6 locally reproducible runs** (`lean`, `leanchecker`, `leanchecker-paranoid`, `con-leche --verified`, `con-ron --verified`, `nanoda_bin 0.4.19`) with 0 forbidden tokens and 0 linter warnings. (On Windows, the bundled `lean4lean.exe` fails locally with an upstream `.olean` header mismatch and is excluded from the completed local kernel count; see [`results/six_kernel_audit.txt`](results/six_kernel_audit.txt).) All 8/8 companion SAT UNSAT proofs are archived as ASCII LRAT certificates (`results/sat_certs/`), independently verified (`scripts/verify_lrat.py`), and cross-checked against both brute-force enumeration and a second independent CNF encoder (`tests/test_all.py`). This preprint has **not** undergone external peer review; confirmed archival identifiers are Zenodo Concept DOI `10.5281/zenodo.24517198` (`v1.0.1`: `10.5281/zenodo.24517199`), Software Heritage SWHID `swh:1:snp:f960eeda6f145e54c0ac52538ace866a16e24085`, and ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648` (arXiv, HAL, and Palomar IDs are not yet assigned). See [`CLAIMS.md`](CLAIMS.md) and [`LIMITATIONS.md`](LIMITATIONS.md).

| Lean Declaration (`lean/Challenge.lean`) | Literature Anchor | Non-Vacuity Witness (`NonVacuity.lean`) | Explicitly NOT Claimed |
|---|---|---|---|
| `T1`, `T1a`–`T1e`, `T1s`, `T1es` (`InRPPass2`, `GF4`, `execRing`, `execAlg`) | Vinciguerra (`arXiv:2609.18692`), Def. 2.2, Thm. 3.5 | `IsPrime 2,3,5,7`; `ModP 5` ($\mathrm{char}=5$); `GF4` (`GF4Hom.id`, $0 \neq 1$) | General $\mathbb{F}_{p^e}$ ($e \ge 2$) closed form; $r \ge 3$ |
| `T2`, `T2b` (`BilinInstr`, `DistinctBilinInstr`) | Strictly bilinear & distinct-operand Def. 2.2 | `F2 = ModP 2` ($0 \neq 1$), $k = 2$, $x = 1$ | Odd characteristics |
| `T3a`–`T3i` (`Pass3InstrR`, `Pass4Instr`, `instCRingFinFun`, `prog5_x7`..`prog9_x15`, global $t=8$ opt, 4-reg powering & streaming $F_D$) | Vinciguerra (`arXiv:2609.18692`), Def. 2.2, Cor. 4.3.1, Cor. 5.1.1; Alekseev et al. (MFCS 2025, Lem. 8) | `ModP 5, 7, 11, 13` ($0 \neq 1$) with explicit $D_5^{-1}\!\dots D_9^{-1}$, $12!^{-1}$, $6!^{-1}$ | Bad primes dividing $D_t$ or $(\ell+1)!$; uniform $t \ge 10$; upper bounds; bit-space accounting |
| `T4_BalancedMultilinearProduct` (`CatOp`) | Zero-workspace strictly distinct bilinear ops | `Int` ($0 \neq 1$), $d = 4$, 36 ops, clean restoration | Non-power-of-two $d$ without padding; lower-bound optimality |

## Core Mathematical Results

1. **Theorem T1 — Complete Base-$p$ Digit-Sum Dichotomy for $\mathrm{RP}_{\mathbb{F}_p}^{\mathrm{pass}}(2, t)$** ([`DigitSumDichotomy.lean`](lean/Catalytic/DigitSumDichotomy.lean)):
   For every prime $p$, every budget $t \ge 1$, and every univariate polynomial $f(x) = \sum_{d \ge 0} \alpha_d x^d \in \mathbb{F}_p[x]$:
   $$f \in \mathrm{RP}_{\mathbb{F}_p}^{\mathrm{pass}}(2, t) \quad \Longleftrightarrow \quad \forall\, d \ge 2 \text{ with } \alpha_d \neq 0,\;\; s_p(d) \le \min(p - 1,\; t - 1).$$
   - **T1a:** $x^{p^m} \in \mathrm{RP}_{\mathbb{F}_p}^{\mathrm{pass}}(2, 2)$ for all $m \ge 0$ ($D_{2,\mathbb{F}_p}^{\mathrm{pass}}(2) = +\infty$).
   - **T1b:** Exact $\mathbb{F}_2$ saturation: $x^3 \notin \mathrm{RP}_{\mathbb{F}_2}^{\mathrm{pass}}(2, t)$ for **all** $t \ge 0$.
   - **T1c:** Universal impossibility threshold: whenever $s_p(d) \ge p$, $x^d \notin \mathrm{RP}_{\mathbb{F}_p}^{\mathrm{pass}}(2, t)$ for all $t \ge 1$.
   - **T1d:** Characteristic-0 recovery: whenever $2 \le d < p$, $x^d \in \mathrm{RP}_{\mathbb{F}_p}^{\mathrm{pass}}(2, t) \iff t \ge d + 1$.

2. **Theorem T2 — Strictly Bilinear 2-Access Frobenius Collapse over Characteristic 2** ([`BilinearFrobenius.lean`](lean/Catalytic/BilinearFrobenius.lean)):
   Under strictly bilinear updates $R_i \leftarrow R_i + R_j R_\ell$ ($j, \ell \neq i$, passive $R_0$), for every $k \ge 1$ and every `Char2CRing` $R$, $x^{2^k}$ is cleanly computed in $k + 1$ registers, $4k - 2$ bilinear ops, and **2 input accesses**.

3. **Theorem T3 — Strict Improvement Over Vinciguerra's 3-Register Powering, Streaming, and Matrix-Powering Exponent** ([`ThreeRegisterBreakthrough.lean`](lean/Catalytic/ThreeRegisterBreakthrough.lean)):
   Explicit Definition 2.2 Pascal-row shear loops give $x^7 \in \mathrm{RP}(3, 5)$ ($D_5 = 576$, $\log_7 5 \approx 0.82709$), $x^9 \in \mathrm{RP}(3, 6)$ ($D_6 = 382{,}500{,}000$, $\log_9 6 \approx 0.81546$), $x^{11} \in \mathrm{RP}(3, 7)$ ($\log_{11} 7 \approx 0.81151$), $x^{13} \in \mathrm{RP}(3, 8)$ ($\mathbf{\log_{13} 8 \approx 0.81071}$ — unique global integer minimizer of $\log_{2t-3} t$ for all $t \ge 4$), and $x^{15} \in \mathrm{RP}(3, 9)$ ($\log_{15} 9 \approx 0.81137$), strictly improving Vinciguerra's $\log_5 4 \approx 0.86135$ for $4$-register powering (Cor. 4.3.1) and catalytic streaming (Cor. 5.1.1) via `prog8_x13`, and tightening non-commutative matrix powering (Thm. 5.2) to $\log_7 5 \approx 0.82709$ at the exact $r = 3$ scalar register tier via `prog5_x7`.

4. **Theorem T4 — Balanced Zero-Workspace Bilinear Multilinear Product** ([`BalancedProduct.lean`](lean/Catalytic/BalancedProduct.lean)):
   Over any commutative ring $R$, for $d = 2^k$, cleanly computes $x_0 \cdots x_{d-1}$ with zero clean workspace, $\log_2 d + 2$ registers, strictly pairwise-distinct indices, and exact primitive op count $(7d^2 - 4)/3$.

## Quickstart

Prerequisites: **Lean 4.35.0** (`elan`), **Python 3.13**, **Tectonic** (CaDiCaL 2.1.2 is bundled with Lean 4.35.0).

```bash
# 1. Install pinned Python dependencies
python -m venv .venv
# Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate   |   Linux/macOS: source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.lock.txt

# 2. Run the full end-to-end verification pipeline (Lean + tests + figures + PDF + LRAT + REUSE + SHA-256)
just reproduce
# Or on Windows PowerShell without `just`:
pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/run_all.ps1 -Task all
# Or on Linux/macOS without `just`:
bash scripts/run_all.sh all
```

Expected result: 19/19 default Lean jobs built with 0 warnings, `leanchecker`, `leanchecker-paranoid`, `con-leche`, and `con-ron` exit 0, all 24 `pytest` / Hypothesis / mutant / differential-SAT / LRAT / REUSE / SBOM / workflow / schema / SVG / HTML5 / matrix-lift / factorization / JS Adaptive Forking differential consistency tests PASS, 3 deterministic PDFs generated, 0-warning Tectonic PDF compile, 100% `MANIFEST.sha256` verification, and DigiCert RFC 3161 `Verification: OK`.

## Usage and Examples

### Common Path — Verify Lean Proofs & Run Exact Test Suite
```bash
cd lean && lake build && lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean && lake env leanchecker-paranoid Solution
cd .. && pytest -v tests/test_all.py
```

### Advanced Path — Export Proof Stream to External Kernels & Audit Repository
```bash
cd lean
lake env leanexport Solution -- Catalytic.Solution.prove_all_catalytic_theorems Catalytic.NonVacuity.nonvac_all_hypotheses > /tmp/sol.ndjson
lake env con-leche --verified /tmp/sol.ndjson
lake env con-ron --verified /tmp/sol.ndjson
cd ..
python scripts/check_citations.py --offline
pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/Audit-Repo.ps1 -Path .
```

### Negative / Failure Path — Verifying Impossibility & Mutant Rejection
```bash
# Run the dedicated negative, hygiene, & mutant-killing tests (confirms x^3 over F_2 fails and corrupted certificates are rejected)
pytest -v tests/test_all.py -k "mutant or hygiene or bruteforce"
```

## FILE: CLAIMS.md

<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0 -->
# Machine-Auditable Claims Ledger (`CLAIMS.md`)

Every scientific claim in `catalytic-register-frontiers` is assigned an explicit epistemic tier and an explicit refutation condition (Build Standard B04, B42):

- **`TIER-1 (Lean 4.35 Multi-Kernel)`**: Formally verified from first principles in `lean/Solution.lean` + `lean/Catalytic/NonVacuity.lean` (zero Mathlib, zero forbidden tokens, strict core linters clean, axioms $\subseteq \{\text{propext}, \text{Classical.choice}, \text{Quot.sound}\}$, 6 passing kernel runs across 5 implementations).
- **`TIER-2 (Exact-Arithmetic / SAT-Certified)`**: 100% exact integer, rational (`fractions.Fraction`), finite-field ($\mathbb{F}_p$, $\mathbb{F}_4$), or CaDiCaL 2.1.2 SAT/UNSAT computation verified by `pytest`, Hypothesis property tests, mutant checks, and brute-force SAT encoder equivalence tests.
- **`TIER-3 (Paper-Level Reduction)`**: Standard mathematical deduction combining our Tier-1 theorems (`T3a`, `T3d`, `T3h`, `T3i`) with published reductions in Vinciguerra (`arXiv:2609.18692`, Corollary 5.1.1 bit-space accounting, §4.4, and Theorem 5.2).
- **`TIER-4 (Open Frontier)`**: Explicitly unresolved conjecture or research question.

## Tier-1 Machine-Checked Lean 4.35 Theorems

| ID | Statement (`lean/Challenge.lean`) | Proof (`lean/Solution.lean`) | Exact `#print axioms` | Verification |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `T1a` | `T1a_TwoAccessFrobeniusCollapse` ($\forall p\text{ prime},\, m,\, x^{p^m} \in \mathrm{RP}_{\mathbb{F}_p}^{\mathrm{pass}}(2, 2)$) | `t1a_two_access_frobenius_collapse` | `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` | 5 kernels (6 runs) |
| `T1b` | `T1b_F2Saturation` ($\forall t,\, x^3 \notin \mathrm{RP}_{\mathbb{F}_2}^{\mathrm{pass}}(2, t)$) | `t1b_f2_saturation` | `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` | 5 kernels (6 runs) |
| `T1c` | `T1c_ImpossibilityThreshold` ($s_p(d) \ge p \implies \forall t,\, x^d \notin \mathrm{RP}_{\mathbb{F}_p}^{\mathrm{pass}}(2, t)$) | `t1c_impossibility_threshold` | `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` | 5 kernels (6 runs) |
| `T1d` | `T1d_VinciguerraRecovery` ($2 \le d < p \implies (x^d \in \mathrm{RP}_{\mathbb{F}_p}^{\mathrm{pass}}(2, t) \iff d + 1 \le t)$) | `t1d_vinciguerra_recovery` | `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` | 5 kernels (6 runs) |
| `T1e` | `T1e_ExtensionFieldSeparation` (exact sharp $\mathbb{F}_4$ separation: $x^5 \in \mathrm{RP}(2, 3) \setminus \mathrm{RP}(2, 2)$, $x^3 \in \mathrm{RP}(2, 4) \setminus \mathrm{RP}(2, 3)$, and $\forall t,\, x^7 \notin \mathrm{RP}(2, t)$) | `t1e_extension_field_separation` | `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` | 5 kernels (6 runs) |
| `T1s` | `T1s_Pass2RingSoundness` (literal `CRing` execution `Pass2Prog.execRing` agrees identically with symbolic `Pass2Prog.exec` over every char-$p$ commutative ring $R$) | `t1s_pass2_ring_soundness` | `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` | 5 kernels (6 runs) |
| `T1es` | `T1es_Pass2GF4Soundness` (literal `GF4`-algebra execution `Pass2GF4Prog.execAlg` agrees identically with symbolic `Pass2GF4Prog.exec` over every commutative $\mathbb{F}_4$-algebra $(R, \varphi)$) | `t1es_pass2_gf4_soundness` | `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` | 5 kernels (6 runs) |
| `T2` | `T2_BilinearFrobeniusCollapse` ($\forall k \ge 1$, $x^{2^k}$ cleanly in $k+1$ regs, $4k-2$ bilinear ops, **2** input accesses over any `Char2CRing`) | `t2_bilinear_frobenius_collapse` | `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` | 5 kernels (6 runs) |
| `T2b` | `T2b_DistinctOperandFrobenius` ($\forall k \ge 1$, $x^{2^k}$ cleanly in $k+2$ regs using strictly pairwise-distinct bilinear operands + passive linear copies, **2** input accesses over any `Char2CRing`) | `t2b_distinct_operand_frobenius` | `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` | 5 kernels (6 runs) |
| `T3a` | `T3a_ThreeReg5CallX7` ($x^7 \in \mathrm{RP}_R^{\mathrm{pass}}(3, 5)$ whenever $576$ invertible, i.e., $\mathrm{char} \neq 2, 3$) | `t3a_three_reg_5call_x7` | `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` | 5 kernels (6 runs) |
| `T3b` | `T3b_ThreeReg6CallX9` ($x^9 \in \mathrm{RP}_R^{\mathrm{pass}}(3, 6)$ whenever $382{,}500{,}000$ invertible, i.e., $\mathrm{char} \notin \{2,3,5,17\}$) | `t3b_three_reg_6call_x9` | `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` | 5 kernels (6 runs) |
| `T3c` | `T3c_ThreeReg7CallX11` ($x^{11} \in \mathrm{RP}_R^{\mathrm{pass}}(3, 7)$ over $\mathbb{Q}$ and good prime fields) | `t3c_three_reg_7call_x11` | `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` | 5 kernels (6 runs) |
| `T3d` | `T3d_ThreeReg8CallX13` ($x^{13} \in \mathrm{RP}_R^{\mathrm{pass}}(3, 8)$, optimal exponent $\log_{13} 8 \approx 0.810714$) | `t3d_three_reg_8call_x13` | `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` | 5 kernels (6 runs) |
| `T3e` | `T3e_ExponentChain` (exact `Nat` proof of $\log_{13} 8 < \frac{30}{37} < \log_{11} 7 < \frac{13}{16} < \log_9 6 < \frac{9}{11} < \log_7 5 < \frac{5}{6} < \log_5 4$ and $< \log_{15} 9$) | `t3e_exponent_chain` | *(none — zero axioms)* | 5 kernels (6 runs) |
| `T3f` | `T3f_GlobalIntegerOptimality` ($8^{37} < 13^{30}$ and $\forall t \ge 4,\, t \ne 8 \implies (2t-3)^{30} < t^{37}$, proving $\log_{13} 8 < \frac{30}{37} < \log_{2t-3} t$ for ALL $t \ge 4$) | `t3f_global_integer_optimality` | `propext`, `Quot.sound` | 5 kernels (6 runs) |
| `T3g` | `T3g_ThreeReg9CallX15` ($x^{15} \in \mathrm{RP}_R^{\mathrm{pass}}(3, 9)$ whenever $D_9$ invertible, post-minimum ascent point $\log_{15} 9 \approx 0.811368$) | `t3g_three_reg_9call_x15` | `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` | 5 kernels (6 runs) |
| `T3h` | `T3h_FourRegPowering` (complete 4-register passive powering for EVERY $N \ge 1$ over any `CRing`: $< \frac{104}{3} \cdot 8^\ell \le \frac{8}{3}\cdot 13 N^{\log_{13} 8}$ when $D_8, 12!, (\ell+1)!$ invertible; $< \frac{70}{3} \cdot 5^{\ell'} \le \frac{10}{3}\cdot 7 N^{\log_7 5}$ when $6!, (\ell'+1)!$ invertible; promotes Corollary 5.2 from Tier-3 to Tier-1!) | `t3h_four_reg_powering` | `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` | 5 kernels (6 runs) |
| `T3i` | `T3i_StreamingFrequencyMoment` (pointwise product-ring `CRing (Fin n → R)` instantiation of `T3h`: for EVERY universe size $n$ and moment $D \ge 1$, cleanly evaluates the frequency-moment vector $(f_0^D, \dots, f_{n-1}^D)$ and its exact sum $F_D(\mathbf{f}) = \sum_{i<n} f_i^D$ in $< \frac{104}{3} \cdot 8^\ell \le \frac{8}{3}\cdot 13 D^{\log_{13} 8}$ vector-stream passes whenever $D_8, 12!, (\ell+1)!$ invertible) | `t3i_streaming_frequency_moment` | `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` | 5 kernels (6 runs) |
| `T4` | `T4_BalancedMultilinearProduct` ($\forall k$, $d=2^k$, clean $x_0\cdots x_{d-1}$ with $0$ workspace, every op explicitly constrained by `CatOp.usesOnly` to $\le k+2$ designated regs, $(7d^2-4)/3$ ops) | `t4_balanced_multilinear_product` | `propext`, `Quot.sound` | 5 kernels (6 runs) |
| `ALL` | Conjunction of all 20 theorems above | `prove_all_catalytic_theorems` | `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` | 5 kernels (6 runs) |
| `NONVAC` | Concrete $0 \neq 1$ ring/prime/evaluation witnesses for `T1`–`T4` (incl. `ModP 5` $\mathrm{char}=5$, `ModP 7`/`ModP 13` for `T3h`, `GF4Hom.id`, and all five $D_5 \dots D_9$) | `Catalytic.NonVacuity.nonvac_all_hypotheses` | `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` | 5 kernels / 6 runs (`con-leche`, `con-ron`, `nanoda_bin`) |

## Tier-2 Exact-Arithmetic & SAT-Certified Claims

| ID | Summary | Artifact | Pytest Guard |
|---|---|---|---|
| `E1` | Exhaustive $\mathbb{F}_2, \mathbb{F}_3, \mathbb{F}_5, \mathbb{F}_7$ verification ($d=2..120$/$100$): 107 feasible degrees ($s_p+1$), 82 exhaustive subset lower-bound audits, 349 impossible degrees ($s_p \ge p$). | `results/exp1_digit_sum.json` | `test_t1_prime_field_dichotomy_exact` |
| `E2` | Exact $\mathbb{F}_4$ extension-field spectrum ($d=1..16$): $x^5, x^{10} \to 3$ calls; $x^3, x^6, x^9, x^{12} \to 4$ calls; $x^7, x^{11}, x^{13}, x^{14}, x^{15}$ impossible $\forall t$. | `results/exp1_digit_sum.json` | `test_t1_extension_field_f4_spectrum` |
| `E3` | Exact $\mathbb{Z}[x, u, v]$ and $\mathbb{F}_p$ replay of $r=3$, $t=4..9$ ($x^5, x^7, x^9, x^{11}, x^{13}, x^{15}$), full prime factorizations of $D_t$, and all 9 integer exponent-chain inequalities. | `results/exp2_three_register.json` | `test_t3_three_register_breakthrough_exact` |

| `E5` | Exact CaDiCaL 2.1.2 SAT companion audit + brute-force $n=2, 3$ encoder equivalence audit + **8/8** archived & verified LRAT UNSAT proofs (`18,932` derived steps via `scripts/verify_lrat.py`): $\mathbb{F}_4$ mul $\mathrm{MC}_\wedge = 3$, orthogonal bent pair $\mathrm{MC}_\wedge = 3$, 182 degree-3 cancellations, 6/6 hard $(n=4, m=3)$ quadratic maps certified $k=2$ UNSAT, 0 Boyar–Find counterexamples. | `results/exp4_boolean_mc.json`, `results/sat_certs/*` | `test_exp4_boolean_mc_companion_sat`, `test_sat_encoder_bruteforce_equivalence`, `test_lrat_certificates_and_mutant_rejection` |

## Tier-3 Paper-Level Reductions

- **`R1` (Promoted to Tier-1 `T3h`):** Four-register passive powering for all $N \ge 1$ (`Cor. 5.2`) is now **fully machine-checked in Lean 4.35** (`lean/Catalytic/FourRegisterPowering.lean`, `T3h_FourRegPowering`) across all 5 distinct kernel implementations (6 runs)!
- **`R2` (Catalytic streaming frequency moments $F_D(\sigma)$ — algebraic pass bound promoted to Tier-1 `T3i`; bit-space accounting Tier-3):** The algebraic vector powering pass bound ($F_D(\mathbf{f}) = \sum_{i<n} f_i^D$ cleanly computed over the product ring `Fin n → R` in $< \frac{104}{3} \cdot 8^\ell \le \frac{8}{3} \cdot 13 D^{\log_{13} 8}$ passes for every $n$ and $D \ge 1$) is now **machine-checked in Lean 4.35** (`T3i_StreamingFrequencyMoment`, `FourRegisterPowering.lean`). The remaining bit-space accounting over $\mathbb{F}_p^n$ with $p > \max(12, m^D, \lfloor\log_{13} D\rfloor + 1)$ and $p \nmid D_8$ — $O(n D \log(m+1))$ catalytic bits and $O(D \log(m+1) + \log n + \log D)$ regular workspace bits (matching Corollary 5.1.1 of `arXiv:2609.18692`) — stays Tier-3.
- **`R3` (Non-commutative matrix powering $A^N$):** Lifting `T3a` (`prog5_x7`, shear degree $d = 2$) via Vinciguerra §4.4's $\ell_A(z)$ homogeneous lift cleanly computes $A^N$ for $A \in M_m(\mathbb{F}_p)$ ($p > \max(7, \lfloor \log_7 N \rfloor + 1)$) using at most $\frac{10}{3} \cdot 7 \cdot N^{\log_7 5} = O(N^{0.82709})$ recursive matrix calls and the **exact** $r=3$ scalar register count $2m^2 + \binom{m^2+2}{2} - 1 = 3m^2 + \binom{m^2+1}{2}$ (zero extra scalar registers vs. Theorem 5.2 of `arXiv:2609.18692`). Lifting `T3d` (`prog8_x13`, shear degree $d = 6$, $p > \max(13, \lfloor \log_{13} N \rfloor + 1)$, $p \nmid D_8$) achieves $O(N^{0.81072})$ calls using $3m^2 + \binom{m^2+5}{6} = \Theta(m^{12})$ scalar registers. (Concrete non-commutative instances — literal $\mu_7(\texttt{prog5\_x7})$ on $M_2(\mathbb{F}_{11})$ with non-commuting catalytic $(O_0, u_0(z), v_0(z))$, single-catalyst $\mu_2$-lifted and 2-factor Cook–Mertz $A^{23}$ on $M_2(\mathbb{F}_{11})$ / $M_3(\mathbb{F}_{11})$, and the scalar-register identity for $m = 1..20$ — are independently verified in exact modular arithmetic by `test_pass9_cor54_matrix_lift_and_blueprint_integrity` in `tests/test_all.py`; the general symbolic matrix-lift theorem stays Tier-3.)

## What Would Prove Us Wrong (Refutation & Falsification Criteria — Build Standard B42)

Every claim in this repository is explicitly falsifiable:

1. **Refuting Formal Correctness (`T1`–`T4`, `NONVAC`):** Any of: (a) a clean rebuild of `lean/` failing or emitting any axiom outside `{propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}`; (b) any of the 5 distinct kernel implementations across 6 runs (`lean`, `leanchecker`, `leanchecker-paranoid`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`, `nanoda_bin`) rejecting the exported proof stream; or (c) any mismatch between `lean/Challenge.lean` definitions and Vinciguerra (`arXiv:2609.18692`, Def. 2.2) documented in `docs/statement-fidelity.md`.
2. **Refuting `T1` (Digit-Sum Dichotomy):** Exhibiting a single prime $p$, budget $t \ge 1$, and passive 2-register program over $\mathbb{F}_p[x]$ cleanly computing a monomial $x^d$ ($d \ge 2$) with $s_p(d) > \min(p-1, t-1)$ — e.g., any clean 2-register program computing $x^3$ over $\mathbb{F}_2[x]$ in any number of calls $t$.
3. **Refuting `T2` or `T4`:** Exhibiting an input/catalytic state where `frobBilinProg` (over a `Char2CRing`) or `balancedProdProg` (over a `CRing`) fails to restore a single catalytic register or violates passive/strictly-distinct operand rules, or fails Hypothesis randomized testing in `tests/test_all.py`.
4. **Refuting `T3` (3-Register Exponent Improvement):** Finding a single input/catalyst triple $(x, u, v)$ where `prog5_x7`..`prog8_x13` fails to compute $O + D_t x^{2t-3}$ cleanly, or finding a good prime $p \nmid D_t$ where reduction modulo $p$ fails.
5. **Refuting `E5` (SAT Companion Audit):** Exhibiting a valid 2-AND unrestricted XAG circuit over $\mathbb{F}_2$ computing $\mathbb{F}_4$ multiplication, the orthogonal bent pair, or any of the 6 UNSAT $(n=4, m=3)$ maps — or finding a single input where our CNF encoder disagrees with brute-force ground truth.
6. **Refuting Novelty:** Citing any peer-reviewed paper or preprint predating 2026-11-23 that already proved Theorem `T1` (exact base-$p$ digit-sum IFF for $\mathrm{RP}_{\mathbb{F}_p}^{\mathrm{pass}}(2, t)$) or `T3d` ($x^{13} \in \mathrm{RP}_K^{\mathrm{pass}}(3, 8)$ achieving $\log_{13} 8$). If found, we will immediately log it in `ERRATA.md` and reframe to formalization/rediscovery.

## Tier-4 Open Frontiers (Explicitly Unresolved)

- **`O1`**: Uniform proof of $D_{3,\mathbb{Q}}^{\mathrm{pass}}(t) = 2t - 3$ for all $t \ge 4$ (and matching upper bounds for $r \ge 3$).
- **`O2`**: Whether non-triangular or multi-stage $r = 4$ loops can reach $N \ge 10$ at $t=5$ or $N \ge 13$ at $t=6$ to beat Vinciguerra's $r=4$ exponent $\log_7 4 \approx 0.71241$.
- **`O3`**: General closed-form combinatorial characterization of $\mathrm{RP}_{\mathbb{F}_{p^e}}^{\mathrm{pass}}(2, t)$ over non-prime extension fields ($e \ge 2$).
- **`O4`**: Boyar–Find conjecture (TCS 720, 2018) and Morse's $n = 5$ binary polynomial multiplication program (`arXiv:2608.30238`).

## FILE: LIMITATIONS.md

<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0 -->
# Limitations, Epistemic Scope, and Negative Findings (`LIMITATIONS.md`)

This document explicitly states what `catalytic-register-frontiers` **does not** prove, documents negative computational findings, and classifies discovered defects using the taxonomy `{bug, error, issue, problem, dilemma, conflict}`.

## 1. Explicit Scope Boundaries

1. **Prime fields vs. extension fields (Theorems T1 & T1e):**
   Theorem `T1` (`rp_pass_two_iff`) holds unconditionally for every **prime field** $\mathbb{F}_p$. It does **not** hold verbatim for non-prime finite fields $\mathbb{F}_{p^e}$ ($e \ge 2$): Theorem `T1e` (`ExtensionFieldSeparation.lean`) now formally proves in Lean 4.35 that over $\mathbb{F}_4$, $x^5 \in \mathrm{RP}_{\mathbb{F}_4}^{\mathrm{pass}}(2, 3)$ and $x^3 \in \mathrm{RP}_{\mathbb{F}_4}^{\mathrm{pass}}(2, 4)$ while $x^7 \notin \mathrm{RP}_{\mathbb{F}_4}^{\mathrm{pass}}(2, t)$ for all $t$. A general closed-form criterion for arbitrary $\mathbb{F}_{p^e}$ remains open (`O3`).
2. **Formal polynomial cleanliness vs. functional evaluation:**
   Cleanliness in Definition 2.2 is formal polynomial identity in $R[O, R_1, \dots, R_{r-1}, x]$ (equivalently, clean evaluation over every commutative $R$-algebra). If one only required pointwise agreement as functions $\mathbb{F}_p \to \mathbb{F}_p$, then $x^p \equiv x$ functionally and degree $> p - 1$ would collapse.
3. **Finite family ($t \in \{5, 6, 7, 8, 9\}$) vs. all $t \ge 4$ (Theorem T3):**
   Our Lean 4.35 proofs establish all five explicit programs $x^7 \in \mathrm{RP}_K^{\mathrm{pass}}(3, 5)$ (`T3a`), $x^9 \in \mathrm{RP}_K^{\mathrm{pass}}(3, 6)$ (`T3b`), $x^{11} \in \mathrm{RP}_K^{\mathrm{pass}}(3, 7)$ (`T3c`), $x^{13} \in \mathrm{RP}_K^{\mathrm{pass}}(3, 8)$ (`T3d`), and $x^{15} \in \mathrm{RP}_K^{\mathrm{pass}}(3, 9)$ (`T3g`), plus unconditional global integer optimality of $t = 8$ for all $t \ge 4$ (`T3f`). Proving $D_{3,\mathbb{Q}}^{\mathrm{pass}}(t) = 2t - 3$ for all $t \ge 10$ (and matching degree upper bounds) remains open (`O1`).
4. **Bad-prime & finite-characteristic restrictions for $t = 6, 7, 8$ and `T3h`:**
   While `prog5_x7` ($\epsilon = 0.827087$) avoids only $\{2, 3\}$ (matching Vinciguerra's $t = 4$ characteristic requirement!), `prog6_x9` avoids $\{2, 3, 5, 17\}$, and `prog7_x11` / `prog8_x13` avoid two larger primes arising from clearing denominators (`538423, 2512452073` and `137, 1602207194491`). Furthermore, in 4-register passive powering (`T3h`, Corollary 5.2), inverting the digit-program and Cook–Mertz finite-difference denominators $(\delta - 1)!$ and $(\lfloor\log_\delta N\rfloor + 1)!$ requires characteristic $0$ or prime characteristic $p > \max(12, \lfloor\log_{13} N\rfloor + 1)$ with $p \nmid D_8$ (for `prog8_x13`) / $p > \max(6, \lfloor\log_7 N\rfloor + 1)$ (for `prog5_x7`). All constructions hold unconditionally in characteristic $0$.
5. **No $r = 4$ exponent improvement:**
   Our exploratory exact modular search over $r = 4$ triangular closed loops (`deg_v = 2, 3, 4`, `wt(w) = 3..9`, unrestricted monomials) reached $N = 7$ ($t=4$), $N = 9$ ($t=5$, $\epsilon = 0.73249$), and $N = 11$ ($t=6$, $\epsilon = 0.74722$). Because degree grew as $2t - 1$ rather than faster, this family did **not** beat Vinciguerra's $r = 4$ exponent $\log_7 4 \approx 0.71241$.
6. **Boyar–Find conjecture & SAT certificate boundary:**
   `exp4_boolean_mc_companion.py` provides supporting SAT-certified evidence (0 counterexamples across sampled degree-3 cancellations and hard $n = 4$ maps) and does **not** prove or refute Boyar–Find (TCS 720, 2018) or Morse's $n = 5$ conjecture (`arXiv:2608.30238`). Our CNF encoder is verified against an independent exhaustive brute-force enumerator on all 16 $n=2$ functions ($k=0, 1$) and canonical $n=3$ benchmarks in `tests/test_all.py`, AND all **8/8** CaDiCaL 2.1.2 DIMACS `.cnf` + ASCII `.lrat` UNSAT certificates (`results/sat_certs/`, 18,932 total verified steps) are archived and independently verified step-by-step by `scripts/verify_lrat.py` (including mutant-rejection tests in `tests/test_all.py`). They have **not** yet been replayed through CakeML's formally verified `cake_lpr` binary (external binary not installed locally — classified as `problem`; no Tier-1 Lean theorem depends on SAT).
7. **Peer-review, Windows tooling, & archival provenance status:**
   This manuscript has **not** undergone external peer review or external second-machine human reproduction (`REPLICATION.md`). On Windows, `lean4lean.exe` bundled in Lean 4.35.0 fails locally with an upstream `.olean` header-version mismatch (`incompatible header`, classified as `problem`), and `lake check --paranoid` requires POSIX `bwrap`; accordingly, `lean4lean` is omitted from the completed local kernel count (`results/six_kernel_audit.txt`). Correctness of all Tier-1 theorems is certified locally across **5 distinct Lean 4.35 kernel implementations in 6 runs** (`lean`, `leanchecker`, `leanchecker-paranoid`, `con-leche --verified`, `con-ron --verified`, `nanoda_bin 0.4.19`). **Confirmed live archival identifiers:** GitHub (`0thernes/catalytic-register-frontiers`, live CI & SLSA releases `v1.0.0`/`v1.0.1`), GitHub Pages Blueprint (`https://0thernes.github.io/catalytic-register-frontiers/`), Zenodo Concept DOI `10.5281/zenodo.24517198` (`v1.0.1` Version DOI `10.5281/zenodo.24517199`), Software Heritage snapshot `swh:1:snp:f960eeda6f145e54c0ac52538ace866a16e24085`, ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`, and `0thernes-research-archive` record `0TH-2026-010`. **Planned deposits not yet assigned:** Palomar Registry ID (under submission), arXiv ID, HAL ID, and Bitcoin block confirmation for `provenance/MANIFEST.sha256.ots` (`ROADMAP.md`).

## 2. Classified Engineering & Discovery Log

| Type | Observation | Resolution |
|---|---|---|
| `conflict` | Legacy notes cited `0thernes LLC` and MIT vs. Nov 2026 Playbook audit (no LLC legally formed; Apache-2.0 + CC-BY-4.0). | Resolved in `docs/adr/0002-epistemic-scope-and-identity.md`: author `Alexander S. Donahue` (independent researcher), Apache-2.0 + CC-BY-4.0. |
| `bug` | `Poly3.add` initially used well-founded recursion, preventing Lean kernel `rfl` reduction on `exec3Poly`. | Rewrote `Poly3.add` via nested structural recursion (`Poly3.addAux`), enabling pure kernel `rfl` across all 5 distinct kernel implementations. |
| `bug` | PowerShell `Out-File -Encoding ascii` wrapped/CRLF-encoded `leanexport` lines, causing `nanoda_bin` parser panic. | Wrote raw LF binary stream via Python `subprocess`; `nanoda_bin 0.4.19` checks all 3,544 exported `Solution` declarations (and 3,502 `PalomarSolution` declarations) cleanly with exit 0. |
| `issue` | Trial-division prime factoring stalled on $t=9$'s 15-digit cofactor (`638970634117961`). | Upgraded `factor_primes` in `exp2` to Miller–Rabin + Pollard-Rho; runtime dropped to < 1 s. |
| `problem` | $t=5$ with `deg_w = 3` failed to reach $N = 7$, initially looking like an anomaly. | Discovered `deg_w = 2` unlocks $x^7$ at $t=5$ with tiny `D = 576` and bad primes ONLY `{2, 3}`! |
| `dilemma` | Balancing Lean `prog8_x13` (`maxRecDepth 4096`) and `prog9_x15` (`maxRecDepth 8192`) kernel reduction depth against external checker performance. | Verified all 5 distinct local kernel implementations (6 runs: `lean`, `leanchecker`, `leanchecker-paranoid`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`, `nanoda_bin`) accept both in seconds with zero `native_decide`. |

## FILE: REPLICATION.md

<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0 -->
# Clean-Room Replication Guide (`REPLICATION.md`)

Every Lean 4.35 formal proof, non-vacuity witness, exact-arithmetic experiment, `pytest` / Hypothesis / mutant / SAT-equivalence test, deterministic vector PDF figure, and frozen AMS-LaTeX manuscript in `catalytic-register-frontiers` reproduces end-to-end from scratch.

## Prerequisites

- **Lean 4.35.0** via `elan` (`leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0`, pinned in `lean/lean-toolchain`). Zero Mathlib dependency; builds fully offline once the toolchain is installed.
- **Python 3.13** with pinned packages in `requirements.lock.txt` (`pytest==9.2.0`, `hypothesis==6.170.17`, `matplotlib==3.11.2`, `numpy==2.5.5`, `scipy==1.18.1`, `ruff==0.17.6`, `mypy==2.4.1`).
- **CaDiCaL 2.1.2** (bundled with Lean 4.35.0 at `<toolchain>/bin/cadical[.exe]`, or set `CADICAL_BIN`).
- **Tectonic** (`tectonic -X compile`) for compiling `paper/main.tex`.

## 1. One-Command Verification (Windows PowerShell, Linux/macOS Bash, or `just`)

> **Bracket-Path Safety Note:** On Windows paths containing `[...]`, always pass `-LiteralPath` to PowerShell file cmdlets and run `pytest` repo-relative (`tests/test_all.py`).

```bash
# Windows PowerShell
pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/run_all.ps1 -Task all

# Linux / macOS POSIX shell
bash scripts/run_all.sh all

# Cross-platform via justfile
just reproduce
```

Individual stages: `lean`, `experiments`, `tests`, `figures`, `paper`, `audit` (verifies 8/8 LRAT proofs, 100% REUSE/SPDX, offline citations, and `MANIFEST.sha256`).

## 2. Step-by-Step Verification (Linux / macOS / CI)

### A. Clean-from-Scratch Lean 4.35 Multi-Kernel Audit

```bash
cd lean
rm -rf .lake
lake build
lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean
lake env leanchecker Solution
lake env leanchecker-paranoid Solution

# Export self-contained LF NDJSON stream for external verified kernels
lake env leanexport Solution -- \
  Catalytic.Solution.prove_all_catalytic_theorems \
  Catalytic.NonVacuity.nonvac_all_hypotheses > /tmp/catalytic_solution.ndjson
lake env con-leche --verified /tmp/catalytic_solution.ndjson
lake env con-ron --verified /tmp/catalytic_solution.ndjson

# On Linux (with bwrap installed), run Lean 4.35's bundled sandboxed multi-kernel checker:
lake check --paranoid
```

### B. Exact-Arithmetic Experiments, Pytest, Hypothesis, & Linters

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.lock.txt

python experiments/exp1_digit_sum_dichotomy.py
python experiments/exp2_three_register_breakthrough.py
python experiments/exp3_bilinear_and_balanced.py
python experiments/exp4_boolean_mc_companion.py

pytest -v tests/test_all.py
ruff check experiments scripts tests
mypy experiments scripts tests
python scripts/check_citations.py --offline
```

### C. Deterministic Vector Figures & AMS-LaTeX Manuscript

```bash
python scripts/make_figures.py
cd paper
mkdir -p build
tectonic -X compile main.tex --outdir build --keep-intermediates
```

### D. Standalone arXiv Tarball Clean-Room Compilation Test

```bash
mkdir -p /tmp/arxiv_check
tar -xzf dist/arxiv_submission.tar.gz -C /tmp/arxiv_check
cd /tmp/arxiv_check
tectonic -X compile main.tex --outdir out
```

### E. Cryptographic Provenance & Build Standard Audit

```bash
sha256sum -c MANIFEST.sha256
pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/Audit-Repo.ps1 -Path .
```
